# Listening.Pictures

> Listening.Pictures produces documentary films about ecology, recovery, and balance. It is a running series of short films, most under a minute long, of sunrise, weather, and moving water, filmed mostly around Fredonia, New York, and the Lake Erie shore.

Listening.Pictures is the film work of Jonathan H. Woolson, based in Fredonia, New York 14063. The films are published on Vimeo and YouTube. Its motto is "Water is life. All water is connected. We are water."

- Contact: hello@listening.pictures
